title: Friendly ticket area labels
summary: Shelter and Pet Care tickets now show clear labels such as Animal Welfare and Follow Up instead of internal IDs.
changes: Show Title Case service area labels on the Shelter and Pet Care ticket forms, ticket lists and ticket pages.
Fall back to a readable label for any unknown area or subcategory instead of showing the stored ID.
version_rationale: Patch: display-only label fix. Stored values, routes and permissions are unchanged.
validation: TicketOptionLabelsTest fails if any Shelter or Pet Care ticket option label contains an underscore.
Manual check of the Shelter ticket form in the local preview.
known_limitations: The Shelter and Pet Care area lists are still fixed; making them editable is tracked separately.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
